instruction: Add a star to all emails in the local Bills folder

metadata.explanation: Task requires adding stars to ALL emails in the Bills folder (folderID=13). The custom evaluator checks that EVERY message in the folder is starred (not just some). Verified from database: Bills folder has 2 emails, all must be starred. This is stricter than the original task which only checked if at least one was starred.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator verifies ALL emails in the Bills folder are starred, matching the instruction requirement 'Add a star to all emails'
Correct getter logic: Retrieves Thunderbird database file from VM after closing application (via postconfig) to ensure data persistence

Correct metric logic: Queries folder by ID (folder_id=13), identifies starred emails (attributeID=58, value=1), compares total vs starred count, returns binary result (1.0 if all starred, 0.0 otherwise)
Correct parameter handling: Metric function correctly accesses expected parameter as 'expected.get("folder_id")' since framework passes rules dict directly when expected.type='rule'
Appropriate postconfig: Closes Thunderbird window to flush database to disk before reading
Edge case handling: Returns 0.0 for empty folders (total_count == 0)
Correct expected value: folder_id=13 correctly specifies the Bills folder to check
